content.text: I will create the cpu_probe folder, gather system hardware info, extract CPU-related lines, reconcile counts into a candidate number with provenance, write the verification summary, and output the candidate number. Proceeding to run a script that does all steps and prints the candidate.

arguments:
{"script":"mkdir -p cpu_probe
out=cpu_probe/raw_info.txt
{
  echo "---- uname -a ----"
  uname -a
  echo "---- lscpu ----"
  lscpu 2>&1
  echo "---- /proc/cpuinfo ----"
  cat /proc/cpuinfo 2>/dev/null || echo "/proc/cpuinfo not available"
  echo "---- lshw ----"
  lshw 2>&1 || echo "lshw not available"
  echo "---- dmidecode ----"
  dmidecode -t processor 2>&1 || echo "dmidecode not available"
} > "$out"

grep -iE 'cpu|processor|core|logical processor' "$out" > cpu_probe/filtered_cpu_info.txt

# compute values
nproc=$(nproc 2>/dev/null || true)
lscpu_cpus=$(lscpu 2>/dev/null | awk -F: '/^CPU\(s\):/{gsub(/ /,"",$2); print $2}')
proc_count=$(grep -c '^processor' /proc/cpuinfo 2>/dev/null || true)
sockets=$(lscpu 2>/dev/null | awk -F: '/Socket\(s\)/{gsub(/ /,"",$2); print $2}')
cores_per_socket=$(lscpu 2>/dev/null | awk -F: '/Core\(s\) per socket/{gsub(/ /,"",$2); print $2}')
calc=""
if [ -n "$sockets" ] && [ -n "$cores_per_socket" ] && [[ "$sockets" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]] && [[ "$cores_per_socket" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]]; then calc=$((sockets * cores_per_socket)); fi

# choose candidate preferring /proc/cpuinfo count
candidate="$proc_count"
if [ -z "$candidate" ] || ! [[ "$candidate" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]]; then candidate="$lscpu_cpus"; fi
if [ -z "$candidate" ] || ! [[ "$candidate" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]]; then candidate="$nproc"; fi
if [ -z "$candidate" ] || ! [[ "$candidate" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]]; then candidate="$calc"; fi
if [ -z "$candidate" ] || ! [[ "$candidate" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]]; then candidate="unknown"; fi

# write cpu_candidate.txt
{
  echo "$candidate"
  echo "Provenance:"
  echo "nproc: $nproc"
  echo "lscpu CPU(s): $lscpu_cpus"
  echo "/proc/cpuinfo processor count: $proc_count"
  echo "sockets: $sockets"
  echo "cores_per_socket: $cores_per_socket"
  echo "derived sockets*cores: $calc"
  echo "Filtered entries saved in cpu_probe/filtered_cpu_info.txt"
} > cpu_probe/cpu_candidate.txt

# ready_to_report.txt
{
  echo "Candidate CPU count: $candidate"
  echo "Supporting evidence: cpu_probe/raw_info.txt, cpu_probe/filtered_cpu_info.txt, cpu_probe/cpu_candidate.txt"
  echo "Remaining uncertainties: if values disagree, /proc/cpuinfo count is used. If 'unknown', further tools (dmidecode, lshw) or root access may be needed."
  echo "Ready to report: yes"
} > cpu_probe/ready_to_report.txt

# output candidate
echo "$candidate"
"}
